segments.ja266:1.1: Yenāsi kisiyā paṇḍu, yena bhattaṃ na ruccati;
segments.ja266:1.3: Ayaṃ so āgato bhattā [tāto (sī. syā. pī.)], kasmā dāni palāyasi.
segments.ja266:2.1: Sace [na kho (syā. ka.)] panādikeneva, santhavo nāma jāyati;
segments.ja266:2.3: Yaso hāyati itthīnaṃ, tasmā tāta palāyahaṃ [palāyihaṃ (syā.), palāyitaṃ (ka.)].
segments.ja266:3.1: Yassassinaṃ kule jātaṃ, āgataṃ yā na icchati;
segments.ja266:3.3: Socati cirarattāya, vātaggamiva bhaddalīti [kundalīti (sī. pī.), gadrabhīti (syā.)].

lines: Puttassa vacanaṃ sutvā gadrabhī dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Yaso hāyati itthīnaṃ, tasmā tāta palāyahan”ti.
Yaso hāyati itthīnanti, tāta, itthīnañhi garukaṃ akatvā āditova santhavaṃ kurumānānaṃ yaso hāyati, issariyagabbitabhāvo parihāyatīti.
Evaṃ sā itthīnaṃ sabhāvaṃ puttassa kathesi.
Tatiyagāthaṃ pana satthā abhisambuddho hutvā āha –
“Yasassinaṃ kule jātaṃ, āgataṃ yā na icchati;
Yā na icchatīti yā itthī tathārūpaṃ purisaṃ na icchati.
